categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies block storage pruning and flush error handling in BlockManager.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled failure path where a failed flush discards queued pruned block files from memory, leaking disk space until node restart. The issue is an edge-case cleanup omission noted during post-merge review of #35714, with no risk of chainstate corruption since files are still safely unlinked on restart via ScanAndUnlinkAlreadyPrunedFiles.
